prepare creates private exact reservation before state preparation; actual delivery can replace only exact root/admission/ownerEpoch/invocation reservation. markDispatch rereads reservation and rechecks admission/client before commit/send. Session dispatch ticket spans prepare through return and strict delivery/unknown; wait occurs outside ledger queue, so held-sibling window cannot race another same-session ACC preparation. Guard uses shared ten-second deadline and recomputes current pending delivery waits.

Unresolved ledger records continue to block after releasing ticket.

Private nodeWaiting guards actual per-tool lease wait independently of heartbeat-mutated display state; acquired/catch cleanup restores private flag and releases obtained lease if event callback throws. recordUnknown accepts same epoch and no acknowledged delivery even when failed transition removed live permission; it can only downgrade. Already-unknown row returns unchanged first reason. Existing session guard remains before this branch; other business tools still require opaque context, reservation, peer verification and one-shot send permit. Original tc.id is captured independently of batch-composite hash input. stageMain requires exact tool_call_id match before storing row/image indices; 09 passes actual tc.id. A different tool result with the same image bytes cannot acquire this invocation delivery identity.
